mainWeakness: The runner that records new evidence is broken: scripts/evolve.sh used +(0) without enabling extglob, so gen-008+ triggered `((: 008: value too great for base)` and preflight aborted with NEXT_GENERATION_ALREADY_EXISTS.
designLesson: A self-evolution runner is part of the experiment. Silent runner failures accumulate a visible evidence gap and must be surfaced, not skipped.
reason: Honest stand-in for the scheduled daily trigger. No website, prompt or generation file changed; the gap is recorded so the audit trail stays continuous.
